name: Grimoire Limbo
storyline: The player awakens in the Grimoire with no memory of how they got there. As they progress through the world of the grimoire, they will discover their history, the reason they are in the Grimoire, and the dark tale of their nemesis, Thranx.
summary:
Trapped in a Necromancer's Grimoire, can you find your memories and escape before losing your mind?

Grimoire Limbo is a turn-based horror adventure set in beautifully crafted, etched-ink environments. 2D sprites interact with the 3D-world like drawings in a book. Every encounter wears on your sanity. Recover a lost memory, and you pull back from the edge. Die, and you slide closer to it.

You can only keep what you can carry - two weapons and two utility items. Every use damages the item a little more until it breaks. Keep the trusted weapon that's almost spent and risk it failing mid-fight, or replace it with one that might not be as powerful but will last a little longer.
